name: Product Feed Manager by Conversios – Google Shopping, TikTok, Meta & 100+ Channels
author: Conversios

sections.description:
Conversios: Product Feed Manager for WooCommerce is the all-in-one solution to create and manage real-time product feeds for Google Shopping, Facebook (Meta), TikTok, Pinterest, Bing, Snapchat, and over 100+ marketing and marketplace platforms.

Easily generate high-quality product feeds using Google Content API, or export via XML, CSV, TSV, or TXT formats — no coding required.

This plugin is built for WooCommerce store owners who want to scale across multiple channels while keeping their product data accurate, synced, and fully optimized for every destination.

Key Features

  • Generate product feeds in XML, CSV, TSV, and TXT formats for compatibility with various marketing platforms.
  • Use 100+ pre-built templates across 200+ countries to speed up feed creation.
  • Add custom attributes like Brand, GTIN, Age-group, Gender, and more without needing extra plugins or custom code.
  • Automate feed generation and updates with scheduled intervals.
  • Keep product data synced in real-time with Google Shopping, TikTok, Facebook, Bing, and others.
  • Target specific products for feeds and campaigns using advanced filtering and flexible product selection.
  • Map product categories and attributes per channel to meet different feed requirements.
  • Ensure compatibility with popular WooCommerce plugins and themes.
  • Easily manage large product catalogs without performance issues.
  • Monitor real-time product approval status and resolve disapprovals quickly.
  • Clean, user-friendly interface for smooth setup and feed management.
  • Free onboarding, feed setup, and account audit included.

Expand your reach and boost your sales with our Product Feed Manager, supporting over 100 diverse marketplaces worldwide.

Supported Marketplaces

Expand your reach with support for over 100 global, specialized, and country-specific platforms.

What Users Are Saying

“We have been using this plugin for over a year. Operation was always at its best. While in the start-up phase, we requested and received all possible assistance in a very short time. We highly recommend trying this plugin.”
— @braincom75

“Efficient plugin for syncing products in Merchant Center. Help docs can be better.”
— Ramnik Chavda

Setup and Configuration

Initial Setup:
After installation, go to the plugin settings in your WordPress dashboard. Follow the on-screen instructions to connect your accounts for Google Shopping, Facebook (Meta), Bing, and TikTok.

Creating a Feed:
1. Go to the Product Feeds tab.
2. Select the desired platform (Google Shopping, Facebook, Bing, TikTok).
3. Choose the products you want to include.
4. Configure feed settings such as format, country, and custom fields.
5. Click Generate Feed to create and sync your product feed.

sections.installation:
1. Install via WordPress Dashboard:

    • Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
    • Search for Product Feed Manager.
    • Click Install Now, then Activate.

  2. Manual Installation:

    • Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
    • In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New.
    • Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded ZIP file.
    • Click Install Now, then Activate.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with other WooCommerce plugins?

Yes, it integrates seamlessly with popular WooCommerce plugins for enhanced functionality.

Can I create feeds for platforms not listed?

Yes, the plugin supports custom feed generation for other platforms using XML, CSV, TSV, and TXT formats.

How often does the plugin update the product feeds?

The plugin automatically updates feeds at set intervals. You can customize the auto-update intervals in the settings.

Is there a limit to the number of products I can include in a feed?

No, the plugin is designed to handle large-scale product management without limitations.

Can I schedule feed generation for specific times?

Yes, you can schedule feed generation to run at specific times to align with your marketing strategies.

What if my feed gets disapproved by Google or Facebook?

Use the real-time product approval status feature to quickly identify and resolve issues that could cause disapproval.

Does the plugin support multiple languages and currencies?

Yes, the plugin supports multiple languages and currencies, making it ideal for global ecommerce.
